rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are compact tariff proclamations that identify an earlier authorization in the recitals, cite the Tariff Act as presidential authority, and then use a single operative clause to terminate the earlier proclamation with a specified effective date. C06 is especially strong because it was issued only months earlier by the same President. C02 and C20 use substantially the same termination machinery but are earlier and concern bilateral trade agreements rather than a special import authorization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 318 of the said Tariff Act of 1930 ... do hereby terminate the said [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE]
shared_material.parent_excerpt: acting under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by the Constitution and the statutes, including the said section 350 (a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, do proclaim that the said proclamations ... are hereby terminated
shared_material.explanation: The operative provisions share the same authority-to-termination construction and directly terminate identified prior proclamations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such termination to become effective on the thirty-fifth day following the date of this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: are hereby terminated as of December 28, 1953
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the operative sentence by prescribing the termination's effective date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... issued under section 318 of the Tariff Act of 1930 ... authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to permit ... importation ... free of duty
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas, under the authority vested in him by section 350 (a) of the Tariff Act of 1930 ... the President ... entered into a trade agreement ... and proclaimed such trade agreement by proclamations
shared_material.explanation: Each begins by identifying the tariff-law authority and the prior proclamation being terminated, then moves through a termination predicate to a short operative revocation.
